title: I Want More Hotbars!
description:
Welcome to the I Want My Hotbars Mod! 
it adds an extra hotbar for the main hotbar by clicking G!
isnt also compatible with 1.21.11, since it was not made for it.
body:
Welcome to The **I Want My Hotbars** Mod!

This mod adds a second hotbar to the main one for extra storage!
- Click G to see second hotbar
- Not the greatest on 1.21.11, since it was not made for it

And thats basically it, have fun playing the mod!

https://discord.gg/jtQAdXKnu6 for mod support and talking!

MaceMeta
